display.purpose: Greeting headline, error SFX and logotype, always with the lettering treatment (paper-white fill, ink stroke, stepped ink extrusion, cyan and magenta plates out of register).

headline.purpose: Empty-state titles, meter count, button calls and count chips in Bangers without plates.

title.purpose: Task titles and composer text; user content is always Archivo.

body.purpose: State explanations, caption summaries, toast text.

label.purpose: Metadata, filter tabs, status, meter caption; condensed via the wdth axis (85%, 78% on narrow viewports).

shadows.value: 1px 1px 0 var(--extrude), 2px 2px 0 var(--extrude), 3px 3px 0 var(--extrude), calc(var(--depth) - 1px) calc(var(--depth) - 1px) 0 var(--extrude), var(--depth) var(--depth) 0 var(--extrude)
shadows.purpose: Body of every inked panel. --depth 5px default; 8px task hover; 7px composer focus; 3px small controls; 2px completed tasks.

shadows.name: halftone-cast
shadows.value: background-image: radial-gradient(var(--cast) 34%, transparent 38%); background-size: 6px 6px; transform: translate(calc(var(--depth) + 6px), calc(var(--depth) + 7px))
shadows.purpose: Ben-Day dotted shadow behind every inked panel; --cast is rgb(20 16 31 / 0.55) by day, rgb(42 212 255 / 0.45) by night.

shadows.name: ink-offset
shadows.purpose: Flat ink drop under yellow buttons, narrator captions and icon tiles inside panels; 5px 5px on button hover. Toasts use 4px 4px 0 var(--extrude).

shadows.name: lettering-extrusion
shadows.value: text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--ink), 2px 2px 0 var(--ink), 3px 3px 0 var(--ink), 4px 4px 0 var(--ink), -3px -1px 0 var(--cyan), 7px 5px 0 var(--magenta)
shadows.purpose: Depth and plate misregistration for display lettering only.

motion.name: on-twos
motion.value: ease: (p) => Math.floor(p * n) / n, or CSS steps(n)
motion.purpose: Stepped frames for every scripted transition: 4 frames for toggles, filter plate, exit and check mark; 6 for entrances and the composer shake; 8 for the meter fill; 13 for the burst.

motion.name: burst-pop
motion.purpose: Completion burst: scale 0.2 to 1.15 to 1, rotate -25deg to -8deg, hold, fade.

motion.name: burst-register
motion.purpose: Cyan and magenta plates settle from 7px out of register.

motion.name: skeleton-drift
motion.purpose: Halftone drift on loading ghost panels.

motion.name: depth-settle
motion.purpose: Transition of the extrusion and cast when --depth changes.

motion.name: direct-spring
motion.purpose: Reserved for direct hover/tap response and panel entrance; not for scripted sequences.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Parallax, skeleton drift, plate registration and burst pop are disabled; the burst falls back to a static fade.

narrative.overview:
TaskBoard is a page of a comic book that happens to be a task manager. Every surface is a panel drawn in 2D that fakes 3D: white paper, a thick near-black ink outline, a stepped ink extrusion to the lower right, and a Ben-Day halftone shadow cast behind it. The page sits over a parallax sky: a cyan dotted sky by day, a violet night with magenta dots after dark, with speed lines, a halftone sun or moon, and two layers of inked skyline drifting at different depths with the pointer and scroll. Everything is CSS and inline SVG; the system ships no raster art.

The palette is four-colour process print: cyan, magenta, yellow and ink on paper. Display type is hand-lettered comic (Bangers) with cyan and magenta plates knocked out of register; working text is Archivo, a variable grotesque whose width axis condenses labels the way a letterer would. Motion is animated "on twos": scripted transitions advance in stepped frames instead of smooth easing, so the page moves like drawn animation. Completing a task triggers the signature onomatopoeia burst.

The style is inspired by the comic art direction of *Into the Spider-Verse* and stops at the art style. The system carries no characters, logos, or franchise imagery. Personality never gets in the way of the task: titles stay plain Archivo, controls stay obvious, and every decorative motion turns off under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Inked panels with ink extrusion plus halftone cast shadow as the only depth system.
Four-colour process palette; yellow narrator captions; magenta as the "done/active" plate.
Bangers lettering with cyan/magenta misregistration for display and SFX only; Archivo for everything you read.
Stepped "on twos" timing for scripted motion; springs only for direct hover and tap response.
Slight hand-pasted tilt on panels; small radii (2-4px) so panels read as cut paper, not cards.
Day and night are two full printings of the same page, not a dimmed copy.

rules.name: The Process Plate Rule
rules.body: Colour comes from the four process plates and the paper. A new accent needs a print reason; there is no fifth hue in the system.

rules.name: The Fixed Ink On Yellow Rule
rules.body: Anything set on Process Yellow uses fixed ink (#14101f) regardless of theme. Yellow never flips, so its text never flips.

rules.name: The Two Printings Rule
rules.body: Night is a second print run: the ground goes violet, the extrusion goes magenta, the cast dots go cyan, the windows go magenta. Never build dark mode by dimming the day palette.

rules.name: The Lettering Is Shouted Rule
rules.body: Bangers carries only shouts: greetings, SFX, button calls, counts and empty-state titles. User content and anything read twice is Archivo.

rules.name: The Width Not Size Rule
rules.body: To fit a label, condense its width axis (100% to 85% to 78%) before shrinking it below 0.75rem.

rules.name: The Printed Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is ink extrusion plus halftone cast, never a blur. If a shadow has a blur radius, it does not belong on this page.

rules.name: The Depth Is State Rule
rules.body: A panel's distance from the page is its state: raised on hover or focus, flattened when done. Change --depth; don't add a new shadow.

dos: Do build every raised surface as an inked panel: paper, 3px ink border, stepped extrusion (default 5px depth) and a 6px halftone cast.
Do express state through depth: 8px on hover, 7px on focus, 2px when done, 3px for small controls.
Do time scripted motion on twos with stepped easing (floor(p * n) / n, or CSS steps()), 4-13 frames; keep springs for direct hover and tap response.
Do set lettering (Bangers with ink stroke, ink extrusion and offset cyan/magenta plates) only on shouted display text: greetings, SFX, the logotype.
Do put fixed ink (#14101f) on Process Yellow in both themes.
Do give panels a slight, stable tilt (within about plus or minus 0.7deg for list items, up to 2deg for single features).
Do draw decoration as CSS gradients and inline SVG; disable every decorative motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use blurred shadows, glassy blur, or soft floating cards; depth is printed.
Don't use violet-to-pink gradients or any gradient other than halftone dots, speed lines and the sky masks.
Don't set task titles or any user content in Bangers.
Don't introduce characters, logos or franchise imagery; the reference is art style only.
Don't add a hue outside cyan, magenta, yellow, ink and paper (danger and the status green excepted).
Don't round panels beyond 4px; a pill or a 12px card breaks the cut-paper silhouette.
